values.note: Six drive-in sites, each on its own gravel loop off the entry road (seen on imagery).

sites.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/schnell-ranch-recreation-area ('Each of the six campsites has a fire ring, grill, picnic table, lantern holder, and garbage can'), read 2026-11-12; loop spurs counted on Esri imagery

values.note: Drinking water only mid-April to mid-October; three vault toilets.

facilities.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/schnell-ranch-recreation-area ('Potable water is easily accessible from every site but is only available from mid-April to mid-October. Three vault toilets are easily accessible'), read 2026-11-12

booking.source: recreation.gov search for 'schnell' returns no facility (README rule: a federal campground with no recreation.gov listing is first-come only); the BLM page names no reservation, read 2026-11-12

note: BLM recreation area on a 2,000-acre former ranch about 1 mi E and 0.5 mi N of Richardton: native prairie and wooded draws, a non-motorized trail system. Campsites have fire rings, grills, picnic tables and lantern holders. --Claude
summary: BLM page confirms 6 campsites, no fee, potable water mid-Apr to mid-Oct, 3 vault toilets; not on recreation.gov (FCFS). Sites are 6 gravel loop spurs about 760 m SE of the stored pin (pin is the ranch HQ). Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: PIN: stored 46.89080,-102.26260 is the ranch headquarters yard. The six campsite loops lie along the entry road to the SE, centred about 46.8849,-102.2576 (~760 m away) on Esri imagery. Suggest location 46.8849,-102.2576.
FIT: each site is a gravel drive-through loop off the road (imagery); the page gives no length, but a 23-ft rig plainly fits a loop of that size.
Phone 701-227-7700 is the BLM North Dakota Field Office (Dickinson), as posted on the page; website confirmed.
